# Mark Attendance

## Summary
Upserts one Attendance Record per enrolment for a live lesson on a day.

## Refuses when
lesson not live; unknown status; missing enrollmentId.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.

## Example
The linked attendance record is what one run of the command writes.
attributes.cardDescription: Records one attendance mark per enrolment for a live lesson on a day, updating a mark that already exists.
